declarations.description:
Data grid with row virtualization, grouping, sorting, filtering (filter
row, header filter, search panel), column resizing, fixing, hiding and
reordering, i18n and SSR.

Name the grid with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` on `<u-grid>`: they
name the inner `role="grid"`/`"treegrid"` table. `aria-labelledby` ids are
resolved in the grid's root (document or enclosing shadow root); their
text is copied and kept in sync.

members.name: autoExpandGroups
members.description:
Groups start expanded. INITIAL default: afterwards expansion is grid
state (`expandGroup`, `expandAllGroups`…); changing it resets that state.

members.name: summary
members.description:
Totals (footer fixed at the bottom) and group summaries (property only).
Recomputed when the data, the grouping or the summary changes.

members.name: noDataRenderer
members.description:
Builds the empty state (property only) shown when there are no rows to
show; `ctx.filtered` tells a filter/search hid every item. Without it,
the translated "No data" text.

members.name: detailRenderer
members.description:
Builds the detail of a row (master-detail; property only). With it, a
toggle column appears at the start and each expanded row is followed by
a full-width detail row (variable height). Returning `null` renders an
empty detail row.

members.name: autoExpandRows
members.description:
Detail rows start expanded. INITIAL default: afterwards expansion is grid
state (`expandRow`, `collapseRow`); changing it resets that state (no
event).

members.name: keyExpr
members.description:
Row key: a property `path` (dots allowed, attribute `key-expr`) or a
function returning the key of an item. Selection (`selectedKeys`), focus
(`focusedRowKey`, `focusCell`) and events use it; without it the key is
the item object itself. With a key, replacing `items` with new objects
keeps the selection, the focus and the group expansion. Changing it
converts the selection to the new keys (keys whose row is gone are
dropped, firing `u-grid-selection-change` with `source: 'api'`).

members.name: dataSource
members.description:
Data source (property only): the grid calls `load(options, signal)` and
shows what it returns — with `remoteOperations`, the server filters,
sorts, groups, summarizes and pages. The grid never builds URLs or
queries: validate the options on the server. Alternative to `items`.

members.name: remoteOperations
members.description:
What the server does with `dataSource` (attribute `remote-operations`:
all or nothing). `false` (default): one call loads every row and the
grid filters, sorts, groups, summarizes and pages. `true`: everything on
the server. An object picks operations; remote `paging` or `grouping`
also turn on remote `filtering`, `sorting` and `summary` (paging also
grouping), with a console warning. Remote operations use the column
`path` (not `valueGetter`, `comparator` nor `groupValueGetter`).

members.name: paging
members.description: Splits the rows into pages (group rows count) and shows the pager below the table.

members.name: pageSize
members.description: Rows per page; also the block size asked to a remote source in virtual and infinite scrolling. Default `20`.

members.name: pageIndex
members.description:
Current page (0-based; with `paging`). The pager writes it; out-of-range
values are clamped. Setting it does not fire `u-grid-page-change`.

members.name: pageSizeOptions
members.description:
Page sizes offered by the pager (attribute: a list, `"10, 20, 50"`);
empty hides the selector. Default `[10, 20, 50, 100]`.

members.name: scrollMode
members.description:
`virtual` (default): every row is in the scroll range and a remote
source loads the visible blocks. `infinite`: the next block loads when
the end is reached (remote paging only; with `paging` the pager wins).

members.name: items
members.description:
Row items (property only). The grid never mutates this array or its
items. Use either `items` or `dataSource` (both = console error, the
data source wins).

members.name: columns
members.description:
Column definitions (property only). When set they take precedence over
the `<u-grid-column>` children. The grid never mutates the array or the
objects.

members.name: sortMode
members.description:
How the user sorts by clicking the column headers: `single` (default)
keeps one sorted column, `multiple` adds columns with Shift+click and
`none` disables header sorting (the API still works).

members.name: rowHeight
members.description: Row height in px (rows with `wrap` columns can grow).

members.name: striped
members.description: Tints even rows.

members.name: showGroupPanel
members.description: Shows the group panel (drop a header there to group). Default `true`; `show-group-panel="false"` hides it.

members.name: showColumnHeaders
members.description: Shows the column headers. Default `true`; `show-column-headers="false"` hides them.

members.name: showRowLines
members.description: Horizontal row separators. Default `true`; `show-row-lines="false"` hides them.

members.name: showColumnLines
members.description: Vertical column separators.

members.name: showGroupCount
members.description: Shows the number of rows in group rows (`"Country: Brazil (3)"`). Default `true`; `show-group-count="false"` hides it.

members.name: groupPanelMenu
members.description:
Context menu of the group panel (right-click, Shift+F10 or the context
menu key on a group chip): ungroup, move the chip left/right (grouping
level), ungroup all, expand/collapse all groups. Default `true`;
`group-panel-menu="false"` disables it.

members.name: columnHeaderMenu
members.description:
Context menu of the column headers (right-click, the "⋮" button, Shift+F10
or the context menu key on a header): group by the column, move it
left/right, auto-size or widen/narrow it. It is the single-pointer
alternative to dragging (WCAG 2.5.7): with `column-header-menu="false"`
the host must provide one. Only actions that apply to the column are
listed; without any, the browser menu is kept. Default `true`.

members.name: showFilterRow
members.description: Shows the filter row below the column headers (an editor and an operation menu per filterable column).

members.name: showSearchPanel
members.description: Shows the search box in the bar above the table (searches the displayed text of the visible filterable columns).

members.name: headerFilter
members.description: Shows a filter button in the headers of filterable columns: a popover with the distinct values.

members.name: filterValue
members.description:
Column filter (property only): a serializable expression such as
`[['age', '>', 30], 'and', ['name', 'contains', 'an']]`. The filter row
and the header filter read and write it, so it always holds the current
filter. The grid keeps a frozen copy (never the host array). Setting it
does not fire `u-grid-filter-change`.

members.name: searchText
members.description: Text of the search panel (case and accent insensitive). Setting it does not fire `u-grid-filter-change`.

members.name: columnResizing
members.description: Lets the user resize columns from the header edge (pointer and keyboard).

members.name: resizeMode
members.description:
`widget`: only the column changes and the total width follows.
`next-column`: the next column gives or takes the same amount (the
total width is kept).

members.name: columnChooser
members.description: Shows the column chooser button in the bar above the table.

members.name: columnAutoWidth
members.description: Columns without `width` take the width of their content (header and rendered rows).

members.name: columnRenderingMode
members.description:
How columns are rendered: `virtual` keeps only the columns in view (plus
the fixed columns and the focused one) in the DOM, for very wide grids;
`standard` renders all; `auto` (default) is `virtual` with more than 50
leaf columns defined (visible, hidden or grouped). Under `virtual` a
column without `width` takes its auto-size width or `max(minWidth, 150)` px.

members.name: selectionMode
members.description:
Row selection: `none` (default; the selection methods do nothing),
`single` or `multiple`. Click selects, Ctrl+click toggles, Shift+click
extends; Space, Shift+Space, Shift+↑/↓ and Ctrl+A on the keyboard.

members.name: showCheckboxes
members.description:
Shows a checkbox column (fixed at the start) with "select all" in the
header. Only with `selection-mode="multiple"`; then a click on a row only
moves the focus and the checkbox (or Space) selects.

members.name: clipboardMode
members.description:
Ctrl/Cmd+C on a cell of the grid: `copy` (default) copies the selected
rows (or, without a selection, the focused cell) as tab separated text
and an HTML table; `none` leaves the clipboard alone. Text selected with
the mouse is copied natively.

members.name: editMode
members.description:
How rows are edited: `cell` (default; a committed cell is saved at once),
`row` (Edit/Save/Cancel buttons per row) or `batch` (changes stay pending
until "Save changes" or `saveChanges()`).

members.name: allowEditing
members.description:
Lets the user edit cells (columns with `editable`, by default those with
`path`). A function (property only) decides per row. The grid never
mutates the items: changes are delivered in `u-grid-saving`. With
`dataSource`, editing needs `keyExpr`.

members.name: allowAdding
members.description: Shows the "Add row" button and allows `addRow()`.

members.name: allowRemoving
members.description:
Shows the Delete button of each row and allows `removeRow()`. A function
(property only) decides per row.

members.name: editTrigger
members.description: Pointer gesture that opens a cell editor: `click` (default) or `dblclick`. Enter and F2 always open it.

members.name: confirmRemove
members.description: Asks before deleting a row with the Delete button (not in `batch` mode, where removal is pending, nor with `removeRow()`).

members.name: selectedKeys
members.description:
Selected row keys (property only). Without `keyExpr` the key is the item
object itself, so replacing `items` with new objects loses the selection.
Keys missing from `items` are kept (and retained) until deselected. The
getter returns a frozen array — the same instance until the selection
changes. Setting it does not fire `u-grid-selection-change`.

members.name: focusedRowKey
members.description:
Key of the data row of the active cell (the cell keyboard navigation
starts from); `null` when it is a header or group row. Setting it moves
the active cell to that row (scrolling to it) without taking the DOM
focus and without firing `u-grid-focus-change`; a key not in the rows is
ignored and `null` moves it to the first header (ignored when
`show-column-headers` is `false`).

members.name: language
members.description:
Language used to resolve the built-in translations. When not set on the
component it is resolved, in order, from the Lit context, the document
(`<html lang>` / content-language meta) and finally the browser.

members.name: stateStorage
members.description:
Saves and restores the user state (see `getState`): `local` / `session`
(`localStorage` / `sessionStorage`, attribute `state-storage`, needs
`state-storage-key`) or an object with `load()` and `save()` (property
only). Read when the grid connects (and again when this or the key
changes), before the first render of data; while an asynchronous `load()`
runs the grid shows the load panel and no rows. Saved
`state-change-delay` ms after each change, and on disconnect or
`pagehide` when a save is pending. A `setState()` before connecting skips
the read. Unreadable or invalid saved states are ignored with a console
warning.

members.name: stateStorageKey
members.description: Key of the state in `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` (required by `state-storage="local|session"`).

members.name: stateChangeDelay
members.description: Delay (ms) after the last change of the state before `u-grid-state-change` fires and the state is saved. Default `500`.

members.name: getState
members.description:
The user state (a new object, JSON serializable): column order, width,
visibility, fixing, grouping and sorting, the filter and the search text,
group expansion, the page, and — with `keyExpr` and string/number keys —
the selection and the expanded detail rows. Never row data. Columns are
identified by `name` (or `path`); columns without either are left out.

members.name: setState

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: `partial: true` changes only the keys present in `state`.

members.description:
Applies a state (from `getState`, your storage or built by hand). It is
validated first: an invalid state is ignored with a console warning; an
older version is migrated, an unknown one ignored. Without `partial`,
every top-level key missing from `state` goes back to the initial value
(the column definitions and the properties the host set before the grid
connected); with `partial: true` only the keys present change. A
`columns` list sets the whole layout: columns missing from it go back to
their definition, at the end in definition order; unknown names are
ignored. Fires none of the per-feature events (like the setters), only
`u-grid-state-change`. Never moves the focus nor announces anything: when
a user gesture triggers it, announce the result yourself.

members.name: resetState
members.description: Puts the state back to the initial one (`setState` with an empty state, without `partial`).

members.name: dispatchEvent
members.description: Os eventos de mudança dizem a origem (`source`) da rajada do estado.

members.name: sortColumn
members.description:
Sorts by `column` in `order` (`null` removes the column from the
sorting). Without `append` the column replaces the current sorting; with
it, the column is added (or keeps its priority if already sorted). For a
grouped column it sets the direction of its groups. A band does nothing.

members.name: clearSorting
members.description: Removes the sorting of every column (grouped columns go back to ascending groups).

members.name: getSorting
members.description: Current sorting, in priority order (a copy).

members.name: groupColumn
members.description:
Groups by `column` at grouping level `targetIndex` (default: the
innermost level). An already grouped column moves to that level. Only
leaf columns group (a band does nothing); a grouped column leaves its
band in the header and returns to the end of it when ungrouped.

members.name: ungroupColumn
members.description: Removes `column` from the grouping; it goes back to the end of its band (or of the regular columns at the top level).

members.name: getGrouping
members.description: Grouped columns, outermost first (a copy).

members.name: expandAllGroups
members.description:
Expands every group of grouping level `groupIndex` (0-based), or of
every level without it. Also applies to groups that appear later
(new data, filter), until the next `expandAllGroups`/`collapseAllGroups`
call or a change of `autoExpandGroups` (which fires no event).

members.name: collapseAllGroups
members.description: Collapses every group of level `groupIndex`, or of every level without it. See `expandAllGroups`.

members.name: expandGroup
members.description:
Expands one group (not its parents). `groupPath` = the group values from
the outermost level, e.g. `['Brazil', 'SP']`, compared as when grouping.
Needs the grouping set (at least `groupPath.length` grouped columns),
otherwise it is ignored; a group that has no rows yet keeps the state
(and the event fires) for when it appears.

members.name: collapseGroup
members.description: Collapses one group (`groupPath` as in `expandGroup`).

members.name: isGroupExpanded
members.description: Whether the group of `groupPath` is (or would be) expanded.

members.name: expandRow
members.description:
Expands the detail of the row `rowKey` (master-detail; without
`detailRenderer` it does nothing). A key not in the rows (filtered out,
in a collapsed group, not in `items`) keeps the state — and the key —
until collapsed; parent groups are not expanded.

members.name: collapseRow
members.description: Collapses the detail of the row `rowKey` (see `expandRow`).

members.name: isRowExpanded
members.description: Whether the detail of the row `rowKey` is (or would be) expanded; `false` without `detailRenderer`.

members.name: getSummaryValues
members.description:
Computed summaries: the totals (`summary.total`) or, with `groupPath`,
the summaries of that group (`summary.group`; empty if the group does
not exist).

members.name: moveColumn
members.description:
Moves a column (or a band, with all its columns) to `targetIndex` among
its siblings — the columns of the same band, or the top level — that are
not grouped (hidden ones count). Without bands that is the index among
the regular columns. The column stays in its band and in its block: fixed
at the start, free, or fixed at the end. A grouped column is ungrouped.

members.name: setColumnWidth
members.description: Sets the width (px) of a column, within its `minWidth`/`maxWidth`. A band does nothing.

members.name: autoSizeColumn
members.description: Fits the width of a column to its header and rendered cells; for a band, each of its visible columns.

members.name: refresh
members.description:
Reloads the data: with `dataSource`, discards the loaded blocks and asks
again (the rows shown stay until the answer); with `items`, recomputes
sorting, filtering, grouping and summaries. Resolves when done (also on
error — see `u-grid-load-error`).

members.name: applyChanges
members.description:
Applies changes to the loaded rows of `dataSource` without reloading
everything: `update` replaces items by key in place (no re-sorting nor
re-filtering, as the reference `push`), `remove` takes rows out, `add`
appends at the end. With remote paging or grouping, `update` patches the
loaded blocks and `add`/`remove` reload the shown rows. Selection, focus
and group expansion are kept. `update`/`remove` need `keyExpr`. With
`items` it does nothing (warning): set a new `items` array instead —
rows keep their state by key.

members.name: getTotalCount
members.description:
Number of data rows: with `items` or a single-load `dataSource`, the
rows that pass the filter; with remote paging or grouping, the server
total (`-1` while unknown, e.g. infinite scrolling).

members.name: clearFilter
members.description: Removes every filter: `filterValue` and `searchText`. Fires `u-grid-filter-change` (`source: 'api'`) when something changed.

members.name: getCombinedFilter
members.description:
The effective filter: `filterValue` `and` the search, as an expression
(copy). The search becomes `[path, 'contains', text]` joined by `or`
over the visible filterable columns (number and date columns included:
`contains` matches their displayed text). `null` without filter.

members.name: openColumnChooser
members.description: Opens the column chooser (also without the `column-chooser` button).

members.name: closeColumnChooser
members.description: Closes the column chooser.

members.name: selectRows
deselectRows
members.description: Removes the rows of `keys` from the selection (nothing in `none` mode).

members.name: selectAll
members.description: Selects every row that passes the filter, including rows of collapsed groups (`multiple` mode only).

members.name: deselectAll
members.description: Deselects every row that passes the filter (`multiple` mode only); other keys stay selected.

members.name: clearSelection
members.description: Removes every key from the selection (also keys not in `items`).

members.name: isRowSelected
members.description: Whether the row of `key` is selected.

members.name: getSelectedItems
members.description: Items of the selected keys that are loaded (all of `items`; with a remote source, the loaded blocks), in selection order.

members.name: focusCell
members.description:
Scrolls to the cell of the row `rowKey` and `column` (default: the first
visible column) and moves the DOM focus to it. Returns `false` when the
row is not in the grid (filtered out or in a collapsed group — groups are
not expanded) or `column` is not a visible, ungrouped column (a band
returns `false`). Before the
first render it only sets the active cell (the focus moves when it is
rendered) and fires no event.

members.name: editCell
members.description:
Opens the editor of a cell (focus goes to it). In `row` mode it opens the
whole row with the focus on that cell. Returns `false` when the row is
not in the grid, the cell is not editable, a save is running or
`u-grid-edit-starting` was canceled.

members.name: editRow
members.description: Opens a whole row for editing (`editMode="row"` only; `false` otherwise or as `editCell`).

members.name: addRow
members.description:
Adds a new row at the top of the visible rows (of the current page with
`paging`) and opens its first editable cell. `data` gives initial values
(also editable in `u-grid-row-adding`). Returns the opaque provisional key
of the row (focus and selection move to the real key when it is saved),
or `null` without `allowAdding`, during a save or when canceled.

members.name: removeRow
members.description:
Deletes a row: in `cell` and `row` modes it is saved at once
(`u-grid-saving`); in `batch` mode it is marked for removal. Never asks
for confirmation. Resolves `false` when nothing was removed (row not
found, `u-grid-row-removing` or `u-grid-saving` canceled, save failed).

members.name: restoreRow
members.description: Restores a row marked for removal (`editMode="batch"`).

members.name: saveChanges
members.description:
Commits the open editor, validates and saves every pending change
(`u-grid-row-validating`, `u-grid-saving`, `u-grid-save`). Resolves
`true` when saved (or nothing was pending).

members.name: discardChanges
members.description: Closes the editor and discards every pending change (`u-grid-edit-cancel` when there was any).

members.name: hasChanges
members.description: Whether there are pending changes (or an editor with a changed value).

members.name: getChanges
members.description: The pending changes, in the order they started (copies). The value of an open editor is not included until committed.

members.name: getExportData
members.description:
The columns and rows the user sees, ready to build any file (Excel, PDF):
visible exportable columns in the current order, filter, sorting, groups
(collapsed ones included) and summaries. The state is read when called;
rows are built in time slices, so a million rows do not freeze the page.
With a `dataSource` whose server pages or groups, only the rows already
loaded are exported (in screen order, without group rows; totals from the
server): ask the server for the full file instead.

members.name: exportCsv
members.description:
CSV (RFC 4180) of what the user sees (see `getExportData`): formatted
texts, UTF-8 with BOM, `;` as separator in languages with a decimal
comma, cells that a spreadsheet would run as formulas prefixed with `'`.

members.name: downloadCsv
members.description: Builds the CSV (`exportCsv`) and downloads it as `fileName` (default `export.csv`).

members.name: focus
members.description: Moves the focus to the active cell of the grid (the one keyboard navigation starts from).

events.name: u-grid-state-change
events.description: `state-change-delay` ms after the last change of the user state (`getState`): user gesture, method, property or `setState` — once per burst, only if the state really changed — and after a restore from `stateStorage` (`sources: ['storage']`, not saved back).

events.name: u-grid-page-change
events.description: The page or page size changed: pager, PageUp/PageDown, a filter gesture (back to the first page) or a clamp after the rows shrank (`source` of the change that caused it). Not the `pageIndex`/`pageSize` setters.

events.name: u-grid-row-expansion-change
events.description: A detail row was expanded or collapsed (toggle, keyboard, `expandRow`/`collapseRow`; not `autoExpandRows`).

events.name: u-grid-group-expansion-change
events.description: After groups were expanded or collapsed (user or API).

events.name: u-grid-group-change
events.description: After the grouping changed (user — drag, Ctrl+G, group panel or column header menu — or API).

events.name: u-grid-edit-starting
events.description: Before a cell editor (or a row, `editMode="row"`) opens (user or API). Cancelable.

events.name: u-grid-edit-cancel
events.description: Pending changes were discarded (Esc, Cancel, Discard changes, `discardChanges`).

events.name: u-grid-row-adding
events.description: Before a new row is added (Add row button or `addRow`): set its initial values in `detail.data`. Cancelable.

events.name: u-grid-row-removing
events.description: Before a row is deleted or marked for removal (Delete button, before the confirmation, or `removeRow`). Cancelable.

events.name: u-grid-saving
events.description: Before saving the pending changes: save on the server with `waitUntil(promise)`. Cancelable: the changes stay pending.

events.name: u-grid-save-error
events.description: The `waitUntil` promise rejected; the changes stay pending.

events.name: u-grid-save
events.description: The changes were saved and applied (`items` copy or `dataSource.applyChanges`).

events.name: u-grid-column-reorder
events.description: The user moved a column or a band (drag and drop, Alt+Shift+←/→ on the header or the column header menu).

events.name: u-grid-column-visibility-change
events.description: The user showed or hid a column (or a band) in the column chooser (one event per own change).

events.name: u-grid-column-fixed-change
events.description: The user fixed or unfixed a column (or a top-level band) in the column chooser.

events.name: u-grid-column-resize
events.description: The user finished resizing a column (pointer release, keyboard, double-click auto-size or the column header menu).

events.name: u-grid-load
events.description: A `dataSource.load` call resolved (not fired for aborted calls).

events.name: u-grid-load-error
events.description: A `dataSource.load` call rejected (not fired for aborted calls); the grid shows the error bar with "Retry".

events.name: u-grid-filter-change
events.description: After the user filtered (filter row, header filter, search panel) or `clearFilter()` ran. Setting `filterValue`/`searchText` does not fire it.

events.name: u-grid-sort-change
events.description: After the sorting changed (user or API).

events.name: u-grid-selection-change
events.description: The selection changed: user gesture, selection method, `multiple` → `single` (not the `selectedKeys` setter).

events.name: u-grid-focus-change
events.description: The active cell changed: keyboard, click, `focusCell` (not the `focusedRowKey` setter nor a relocation).
Before the sorting changes (user or API). Cancelable.
events.name: u-grid-sorting

events.description: Before each call to `dataSource.load` (`dataSource` only). Cancelable: the call is skipped and the rows shown stay.
events.name: u-grid-loading

events.description: Before Ctrl/Cmd+C writes the selected rows (or the focused cell) to the clipboard. Cancelable.
events.name: u-grid-copying

events.description: Before saving, for each added or edited row. Cancelable: `preventDefault()`/`setError` marks the row invalid.
events.name: u-grid-row-validating

attributes.name: auto-expand-groups
attributes.description:
Groups start expanded. INITIAL default: afterwards expansion is grid
state (`expandGroup`, `expandAllGroups`…); changing it resets that state.

attributes.name: auto-expand-rows
attributes.description:
Detail rows start expanded. INITIAL default: afterwards expansion is grid
state (`expandRow`, `collapseRow`); changing it resets that state (no
event).

attributes.name: key-expr
attributes.description:
Row key: a property `path` (dots allowed, attribute `key-expr`) or a
function returning the key of an item. Selection (`selectedKeys`), focus
(`focusedRowKey`, `focusCell`) and events use it; without it the key is
the item object itself. With a key, replacing `items` with new objects
keeps the selection, the focus and the group expansion. Changing it
converts the selection to the new keys (keys whose row is gone are
dropped, firing `u-grid-selection-change` with `source: 'api'`).

attributes.name: remote-operations
attributes.description:
What the server does with `dataSource` (attribute `remote-operations`:
all or nothing). `false` (default): one call loads every row and the
grid filters, sorts, groups, summarizes and pages. `true`: everything on
the server. An object picks operations; remote `paging` or `grouping`
also turn on remote `filtering`, `sorting` and `summary` (paging also
grouping), with a console warning. Remote operations use the column
`path` (not `valueGetter`, `comparator` nor `groupValueGetter`).

attributes.name: paging
attributes.description: Splits the rows into pages (group rows count) and shows the pager below the table.

attributes.name: page-size
attributes.description: Rows per page; also the block size asked to a remote source in virtual and infinite scrolling. Default `20`.

attributes.name: page-index
attributes.description:
Current page (0-based; with `paging`). The pager writes it; out-of-range
values are clamped. Setting it does not fire `u-grid-page-change`.

attributes.name: page-size-options
attributes.description:
Page sizes offered by the pager (attribute: a list, `"10, 20, 50"`);
empty hides the selector. Default `[10, 20, 50, 100]`.

attributes.name: scroll-mode
attributes.description:
`virtual` (default): every row is in the scroll range and a remote
source loads the visible blocks. `infinite`: the next block loads when
the end is reached (remote paging only; with `paging` the pager wins).

attributes.name: sort-mode
attributes.description:
How the user sorts by clicking the column headers: `single` (default)
keeps one sorted column, `multiple` adds columns with Shift+click and
`none` disables header sorting (the API still works).

attributes.name: row-height
attributes.description: Row height in px (rows with `wrap` columns can grow).

attributes.name: striped
attributes.description: Tints even rows.

attributes.name: show-group-panel
attributes.description: Shows the group panel (drop a header there to group). Default `true`; `show-group-panel="false"` hides it.

attributes.name: show-column-headers
attributes.description: Shows the column headers. Default `true`; `show-column-headers="false"` hides them.

attributes.name: show-row-lines
attributes.description: Horizontal row separators. Default `true`; `show-row-lines="false"` hides them.

attributes.name: show-column-lines
attributes.description: Vertical column separators.

attributes.name: show-group-count
attributes.description: Shows the number of rows in group rows (`"Country: Brazil (3)"`). Default `true`; `show-group-count="false"` hides it.

attributes.name: group-panel-menu
attributes.description:
Context menu of the group panel (right-click, Shift+F10 or the context
menu key on a group chip): ungroup, move the chip left/right (grouping
level), ungroup all, expand/collapse all groups. Default `true`;
`group-panel-menu="false"` disables it.

attributes.name: column-header-menu
attributes.description:
Context menu of the column headers (right-click, the "⋮" button, Shift+F10
or the context menu key on a header): group by the column, move it
left/right, auto-size or widen/narrow it. It is the single-pointer
alternative to dragging (WCAG 2.5.7): with `column-header-menu="false"`
the host must provide one. Only actions that apply to the column are
listed; without any, the browser menu is kept. Default `true`.

attributes.name: show-filter-row
attributes.description: Shows the filter row below the column headers (an editor and an operation menu per filterable column).

attributes.name: show-search-panel
attributes.description: Shows the search box in the bar above the table (searches the displayed text of the visible filterable columns).

attributes.name: header-filter
attributes.description: Shows a filter button in the headers of filterable columns: a popover with the distinct values.

attributes.name: search-text
attributes.description: Text of the search panel (case and accent insensitive). Setting it does not fire `u-grid-filter-change`.

attributes.name: column-resizing
attributes.description: Lets the user resize columns from the header edge (pointer and keyboard).

attributes.name: resize-mode
attributes.description:
`widget`: only the column changes and the total width follows.
`next-column`: the next column gives or takes the same amount (the
total width is kept).

attributes.name: column-chooser
attributes.description: Shows the column chooser button in the bar above the table.

attributes.name: column-auto-width
attributes.description: Columns without `width` take the width of their content (header and rendered rows).

attributes.name: column-rendering-mode
attributes.description:
How columns are rendered: `virtual` keeps only the columns in view (plus
the fixed columns and the focused one) in the DOM, for very wide grids;
`standard` renders all; `auto` (default) is `virtual` with more than 50
leaf columns defined (visible, hidden or grouped). Under `virtual` a
column without `width` takes its auto-size width or `max(minWidth, 150)` px.

attributes.name: selection-mode
attributes.description:
Row selection: `none` (default; the selection methods do nothing),
`single` or `multiple`. Click selects, Ctrl+click toggles, Shift+click
extends; Space, Shift+Space, Shift+↑/↓ and Ctrl+A on the keyboard.

attributes.name: show-checkboxes
attributes.description:
Shows a checkbox column (fixed at the start) with "select all" in the
header. Only with `selection-mode="multiple"`; then a click on a row only
moves the focus and the checkbox (or Space) selects.

attributes.name: clipboard-mode
attributes.description:
Ctrl/Cmd+C on a cell of the grid: `copy` (default) copies the selected
rows (or, without a selection, the focused cell) as tab separated text
and an HTML table; `none` leaves the clipboard alone. Text selected with
the mouse is copied natively.

attributes.name: edit-mode
attributes.description:
How rows are edited: `cell` (default; a committed cell is saved at once),
`row` (Edit/Save/Cancel buttons per row) or `batch` (changes stay pending
until "Save changes" or `saveChanges()`).

attributes.name: allow-editing
attributes.description:
Lets the user edit cells (columns with `editable`, by default those with
`path`). A function (property only) decides per row. The grid never
mutates the items: changes are delivered in `u-grid-saving`. With
`dataSource`, editing needs `keyExpr`.

attributes.name: allow-adding
attributes.description: Shows the "Add row" button and allows `addRow()`.

attributes.name: allow-removing
attributes.description:
Shows the Delete button of each row and allows `removeRow()`. A function
(property only) decides per row.

attributes.name: edit-trigger
attributes.description: Pointer gesture that opens a cell editor: `click` (default) or `dblclick`. Enter and F2 always open it.

attributes.name: confirm-remove
attributes.description: Asks before deleting a row with the Delete button (not in `batch` mode, where removal is pending, nor with `removeRow()`).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description:
Language used to resolve the built-in translations. When not set on the
component it is resolved, in order, from the Lit context, the document
(`<html lang>` / content-language meta) and finally the browser.

attributes.name: state-storage
attributes.description:
Saves and restores the user state (see `getState`): `local` / `session`
(`localStorage` / `sessionStorage`, attribute `state-storage`, needs
`state-storage-key`) or an object with `load()` and `save()` (property
only). Read when the grid connects (and again when this or the key
changes), before the first render of data; while an asynchronous `load()`
runs the grid shows the load panel and no rows. Saved
`state-change-delay` ms after each change, and on disconnect or
`pagehide` when a save is pending. A `setState()` before connecting skips
the read. Unreadable or invalid saved states are ignored with a console
warning.

attributes.name: state-storage-key
attributes.description: Key of the state in `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` (required by `state-storage="local|session"`).

attributes.name: state-change-delay
attributes.description: Delay (ms) after the last change of the state before `u-grid-state-change` fires and the state is saved. Default `500`.

attributes.name: rowheight
attributes.description: Deprecated alias of `row-height`.

attributes.name: showrowlines
attributes.description: Deprecated alias of `show-row-lines`.

attributes.name: showcolumnlines
attributes.description: Deprecated alias of `show-column-lines`.

declarations.description:
Declarative column of a `<u-grid>`: one direct child `<u-grid-column>` per
column. The text content is the header label. Every option mirrors a
`GridColumnDef` field with the same property name. A `<u-grid-column>`
with nested `<u-grid-column>` elements is a band (multi-level header).
declarations.name: DataGridColumn

slots.description: Header label text and, in a band, the nested `<u-grid-column>` elements.

members.name: width
members.description:
Width in px. Changing it after the column is rendered overrides the width
chosen by the user. Under virtual column rendering (`columnRenderingMode`)
a column without `width` takes its auto-size width or `max(minWidth, 150)` px.

members.name: groupIndex
members.description:
INITIAL grouping level. Afterwards grouping is grid state: use
`grid.groupColumn()` / `grid.ungroupColumn()`. Changing it after the
column is rendered still regroups, but is deprecated.

members.name: path
members.description: Dot path of the cell value in the row item (`"address.city"`).

members.name: name
members.description:
Stable id of the column in the grid state (`getState`, `stateStorage`)
and in string column references (`summary` items look it up before
`path`). Default: `path`. A column without `name` and `path` is left out
of the state.

members.name: renderer
members.description:
Builds the cell content (property only): a Lit `TemplateResult`
(recommended), a string (text) or an `HTMLElement` (placed in the grid's
light DOM). `null`, `undefined` and Lit's `nothing` render an empty cell.

members.name: headerRenderer
members.description: Builds the header label (property only); sort arrow, filter button and resize handle stay.

members.name: groupRenderer
members.description: Builds the label of the group rows of this column (property only); the expand button and aligned summaries stay.

members.name: dataType
members.description:
Data type of the column (`string`, `number`, `date`, `datetime`,
`boolean`); attribute `type`. Without it, inferred from the first
non-null value. The `data-type` attribute is deprecated (`data-*`
belongs to the page author).

members.name: format
members.description: `Intl` options or a formatter function (property only).

members.name: alignment
members.description: Logical alignment (`start`, `center`, `end`); follows RTL. Default by data type. In a band, of the header label (default `center`).

members.name: valueGetter
members.description: Computes the cell value used to group, sort and filter (property only). Default: read `path`.

members.name: displayValue
members.description: Displayed text (cell and group row); wins over `format` (property only).

members.name: booleanDisplay
members.description: `text` (default) or `icon` (read-only check icon) for boolean columns.

members.name: wrap
members.description: Wraps the text in several lines instead of an ellipsis (`wrap="false"` turns it off).

members.name: minWidth
members.description: Minimum width in px (also when resizing and auto-sizing).

members.name: emptyText
members.description: Text for empty values (`null`/`undefined`).

members.name: maxWidth
members.description: Maximum width in px when resizing and auto-sizing.

members.name: resizable
members.description: `resizable="false"` prevents resizing this column even with `column-resizing`.

members.name: fixed
members.description:
Fixes the column at the `start` or `end` of the scrollable area (logical:
mirrors in RTL). A fixed band fixes its columns; ignored on nested columns.

members.name: visible
members.description: INITIAL visibility (`visible="false"` hides). Afterwards the user changes it in the chooser.

members.name: showInChooser
members.description: `show-in-chooser="false"` removes the column from the chooser (the user cannot hide it).

members.name: sortable
members.description: Allows sorting by this column. Default: `true` when it has a `path`, `valueGetter` or `comparator`.

members.name: sortOrder
members.description: Initial sort direction. Afterwards the sorting is grid state.

members.name: sortIndex
members.description: Priority of the initial sort among columns (lower first).

members.name: comparator
members.description: Custom ascending comparator: `(valueA, valueB, itemA, itemB) => number`.

members.name: groupValueGetter
members.description:
Value used to GROUP by this column (a range or bucket: decade, initial
letter), property only. Groups are identified, sorted and shown by the
returned value; `dataType`, `comparator`, `format` and `displayValue` do
not apply to it.

members.name: groupable
members.description:
Allows the user to group by this column (`groupable="false"` prevents
it). Default: `true` when it has a `path`, `valueGetter` or
`groupValueGetter`. Only limits the user: `groupColumn()` still works.

members.name: filterable
members.description:
Allows filtering by this column (filter row, header filter and, by
default, the search panel). Default (`null`): `true` when the column has
a `path`. `filterable="false"` disables it.

members.name: exportable
members.description:
Includes this column in exports (`exportCsv`, `getExportData`, the
xlsx adapter) and in Ctrl+C. Default (`null`): `true` when it has a
`path`, `valueGetter` or `displayValue` (a `renderer`-only column has no
text). `exportable="false"` leaves it out.

members.name: filterOperations
members.description:
Operations of the filter row operation menu. Attribute: space separated
list (`filter-operations="contains startswith ="`); unknown tokens are
ignored with a warning. Default by data type.

members.name: defaultFilterOperation
members.description:
Operation of the filter row editor. Default: `contains` for text, `=`
otherwise; one outside `filterOperations` falls back to the first of the
list. Unknown attribute values are ignored with a warning.

members.name: editable
members.description:
Allows editing the cells of this column (with `allow-editing` on the
grid). Default (`null`): `true` when it has a `path` or a
`valueSetter`. `editable="false"` makes it read-only.

members.name: editorRenderer
members.description: Builds the cell editor instead of the built-in one (property only). See `GridEditorRenderer`.

members.name: validationRules
members.description: Rules checked when a value is committed and before saving (property only). See `GridValidationRule`.

members.name: valueSetter
members.description: Writes an edited value into the pending change of the row (property only). Default: sets `path`.

members.name: columns
members.description:
Nested `<u-grid-column>` elements (read-only): when there is at least
one, this column is a band. `null` without nested columns. The array is
frozen and stays the same while the nested columns don't change.

members.name: label
members.description: Header label: the trimmed text content of the element, without the text of nested columns.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description:
Width in px. Changing it after the column is rendered overrides the width
chosen by the user. Under virtual column rendering (`columnRenderingMode`)
a column without `width` takes its auto-size width or `max(minWidth, 150)` px.

attributes.name: group-index
attributes.description:
INITIAL grouping level. Afterwards grouping is grid state: use
`grid.groupColumn()` / `grid.ungroupColumn()`. Changing it after the
column is rendered still regroups, but is deprecated.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Dot path of the cell value in the row item (`"address.city"`).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description:
Stable id of the column in the grid state (`getState`, `stateStorage`)
and in string column references (`summary` items look it up before
`path`). Default: `path`. A column without `name` and `path` is left out
of the state.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description:
Data type of the column (`string`, `number`, `date`, `datetime`,
`boolean`); attribute `type`. Without it, inferred from the first
non-null value. The `data-type` attribute is deprecated (`data-*`
belongs to the page author).

attributes.name: alignment
attributes.description: Logical alignment (`start`, `center`, `end`); follows RTL. Default by data type. In a band, of the header label (default `center`).

attributes.name: boolean-display
attributes.description: `text` (default) or `icon` (read-only check icon) for boolean columns.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.description: Wraps the text in several lines instead of an ellipsis (`wrap="false"` turns it off).

attributes.name: min-width
attributes.description: Minimum width in px (also when resizing and auto-sizing).

attributes.name: empty-text
attributes.description: Text for empty values (`null`/`undefined`).

attributes.name: max-width
attributes.description: Maximum width in px when resizing and auto-sizing.

attributes.name: resizable
attributes.description: `resizable="false"` prevents resizing this column even with `column-resizing`.

attributes.name: fixed
attributes.description:
Fixes the column at the `start` or `end` of the scrollable area (logical:
mirrors in RTL). A fixed band fixes its columns; ignored on nested columns.

attributes.name: visible
attributes.description: INITIAL visibility (`visible="false"` hides). Afterwards the user changes it in the chooser.

attributes.name: show-in-chooser
attributes.description: `show-in-chooser="false"` removes the column from the chooser (the user cannot hide it).

attributes.name: sortable
attributes.description: Allows sorting by this column. Default: `true` when it has a `path`, `valueGetter` or `comparator`.

attributes.name: sort-order
attributes.description: Initial sort direction. Afterwards the sorting is grid state.

attributes.name: sort-index
attributes.description: Priority of the initial sort among columns (lower first).

attributes.name: groupable
attributes.description:
Allows the user to group by this column (`groupable="false"` prevents
it). Default: `true` when it has a `path`, `valueGetter` or
`groupValueGetter`. Only limits the user: `groupColumn()` still works.

attributes.name: filterable
attributes.description:
Allows filtering by this column (filter row, header filter and, by
default, the search panel). Default (`null`): `true` when the column has
a `path`. `filterable="false"` disables it.

attributes.name: exportable
attributes.description:
Includes this column in exports (`exportCsv`, `getExportData`, the
xlsx adapter) and in Ctrl+C. Default (`null`): `true` when it has a
`path`, `valueGetter` or `displayValue` (a `renderer`-only column has no
text). `exportable="false"` leaves it out.

attributes.name: filter-operations
attributes.description:
Operations of the filter row operation menu. Attribute: space separated
list (`filter-operations="contains startswith ="`); unknown tokens are
ignored with a warning. Default by data type.

attributes.name: default-filter-operation
attributes.description:
Operation of the filter row editor. Default: `contains` for text, `=`
otherwise; one outside `filterOperations` falls back to the first of the
list. Unknown attribute values are ignored with a warning.

attributes.name: editable
attributes.description:
Allows editing the cells of this column (with `allow-editing` on the
grid). Default (`null`): `true` when it has a `path` or a
`valueSetter`. `editable="false"` makes it read-only.

attributes.name: data-type
attributes.description: Deprecated alias of `type`.

declarations.name: gridLanguageContext
declarations.description:
Lit context carrying the default language for every grid in the subtree.
Uses a shared symbol so duplicate module copies resolve to the same context.

declarations.name: setGridTranslation
declarations.description:
Overrides part (or all) of a built-in translation. Missing keys keep their
previous value, so a partial object is enough. The deprecated key names
(`clearSorting`, `pinStart`, `pinEnd`, `unpin`, `groupPanelMenu`) are still accepted, with a
console warning.

declarations.name: setGridLanguage
declarations.description:
Provides a default language through Lit context on `host` (the document body
by default). Every grid without an explicit `language` inherits this value.
